intents.answer: I can summarize Imad’s background, Oracle and internship experience, project stacks, technical skills, education and languages, or the roles his published experience may fit. I can also point you to the CV and contact links below.
You’re welcome! If you’d like, ask about Imad’s projects, experience, skills, or role fit.

Imad Chakir is a software engineer based in Rabat, Morocco. He earned an engineering degree in Computer Engineering and Digitalization at EMI (2021–2024). His work focuses on backend and API development, DevOps, observability, and QA automation.

At Oracle, Imad contributed to APIGW observability work, moving monitoring to internal Telemetry services and building metric pipelines, Grafana dashboards, and alarms. On the Payment team, he worked on validation and gateway APIs, test automation with Selenium, Rest Assured, and Appium, and internal testing tools. Earlier, he interned at Cheikh Zaid Foundation (2022) and ANFCC (2023).

Selected projects include an investment portfolio platform (Power BI, Python, MySQL, Azure, OAuth, C#, Angular, .NET); a voice-enabled weather app (Angular, Spring, Node-RED, Express, MySQL, Tailwind, Java, ActiveMQ, Mosquitto, Whisper); facial expression recognition (Python, TensorFlow, Keras, OpenCV, FER2013); and an article-sharing platform (React, Spring, MongoDB, Express, Python, Dialogflow).

His listed skills include Python, Java, C#, JavaScript, and SQL; Spring Boot, .NET, Node.js, Express, and REST APIs; Docker, Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, and Linux; Grafana, Prometheus, and Telemetry; and Selenium, Appium, Postman, and API test automation.

Automated API and platform testing with Selenium, Rest Assured, and Appium to expand validation coverage and reduce manual testing effort.
Contributed to APIs for payment request validation and payment gateway integration; worked across multiple payment methods and transaction flows.
Supported enterprise payment customers and built lightweight internal tools to simplify testing workflows and API understanding.
Contributed to early design and implementation work with Redis and Kafka to evaluate support for increasing transaction volumes.
Worked on web and mobile applications in an Agile environment, from planning and design to implementation and testing.
Used C#, Ionic, Postman, IIS, SQL Server, Python, UML, and Figma.
